title: Session timeout logic (4hr hard, 1hr inactivity)
description: Expire session on whichever hits first: 4 hours since auth or 1 hour since last message. On expiry, reset to unauthenticated state. Check timeout before processing each message.

title: General message rate limiting / debounce
description: Rate limit incoming Telegram messages before passing to Claude. Options: simple cooldown (2-3 sec between messages), or smarter debounce (batch rapid messages into one Claude invocation). Protects against accidental floods, keeps API costs predictable, and adds a basic security layer independent of OTP auth.
